description: Source code for the HIP9011/TPIC8101 driver, managing SPI communication, hardware initialization, and engine integration for knock detection and sensor control.

classes.name: Hip9011Hardware
classes.description: Implementation of Hip9011HardwareInterface for SPI communication with the HIP9011/TPIC8101 sensor.

methods.name: sendSyncCommand
methods.description: Sends a synchronous SPI command to the hardware.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends an asynchronous SPI command to the hardware.

methods.name: showHipInfo
methods.description: Displays current HIP9011 driver status and configuration information.

methods.name: setHip9011FrankensoPinout
methods.description: Configures pinout and initial settings for HIP9011 hardware.

methods.name: intHoldCallback
methods.description: Callback for shaft position to start or finish HIP integration based on trigger events.

methods.name: setMaxKnockSubDeg
methods.description: Sets maximum knock sub-degrees and updates display.

methods.name: setKnockThresh
methods.description: Sets knock voltage threshold and updates display.

methods.name: setPrescalerAndSDO
methods.description: Sets prescaler and SDO for HIP9011 SPI configuration.

methods.name: setHipBand
methods.description: Sets HIP bandpass frequency and updates display.

methods.name: setHipGain
methods.description: Sets HIP gain and updates display.

methods.name: endOfSpiExchange
methods.description: Callback after SPI exchange completes, switches hardware back to ready state.

methods.name: hipAdcCallback
methods.description: Handles ADC input for knock voltage measurement.

methods.name: hipStartupCode
methods.description: Initializes HIP9011 hardware and SPI communication.

methods.name: hipThread
methods.description: Thread managing HIP9011 hardware initialization and periodic checks.

methods.name: initHip9011
methods.description: Initializes HIP9011 driver, configures pins, and starts the hardware thread.
